title: chrysothamnus pulchellus var. baileyi
intro: Chrysothamnus pulchellus var. baileyi, commonly known as Bailey's rabbitbrush, is a shrub native to the western United States. This plant has been traditionally used to treat various health issues, including fever, cough, and sore throats, due to its health benefits of reducing inflammation and promoting relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Bailey's rabbitbrush include anti-inflammatory, antiseptic, and expectorant properties, which aid in relieving respiratory issues and promoting wound healing. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
